content:
## Request Context
- **What was requested**: 'build /apply-framework per SPEC-20260524-203931' — run /build_module against the approved, Steward-gated, developer-approved spec for the unified framework apply-or-update command.
- **Files/scope**: SPEC-20260524-203931-framework-apply-unification.md. Extends scripts/distribute/{change_package,assessment,repo_safety_check,stage_branch}.py; new router.py; evolves .claude/commands/distribute.md → apply-framework.md + onboard.md alias; new ADR-0019 superseding ADR-0017; tests/test_distribute.py. Built in worktree feat/distribute-b1-floor (carries B1 base ef9a485).
- **Developer-stated motivation**: one mental model — 'apply or update the framework on this project, show me value+risk first, then let me deploy safely.' Today it's two commands (/distribute, /onboard) with a hard split at lineage-presence.
- **Explicit constraints**: ASSESS read-only by construction; DEPLOY clean-tree-gated + back-out branch; never push/auto-merge; one target at a time. Steward conditions: (1) ADR records lineage-absence≠ownership inversion; (2) APPLY assent fail-closed (primary_human:null blocks); (3) stub written inside branched deploy so back-out reverts it; (4) baseline_gate_green defaults skip on APPLY. Architecture (b) two engines+shared shell behind injected Baseline; consent (ii) write-assent-into-target.

Build plan (5 tasks + tests):
T1 change_package.py — inject Baseline protocol (LineageBaseline/OnDiskBaseline); extract the single floor primitive so _classify is route-agnostic; add compute_greenfield_package + bounded greenfield_offer_set (hub framework corpus, capped). [checkpoint: architecture-consultant + independent-perspective]
T2 gating+consent+deploy — new router.py (presence detection → route spectrum present/partial-N/greenfield, fail-closed); decompose repo_safety_check into separable check_clean_tree + manifest_presence + pluggable consent preflight (update_consent unchanged; apply_assent_preflight fail-closed on primary_human null); build_assent_stub; stage_branch extra_files for deploy-step-zero stub (back-out reverts). [checkpoint: security-specialist + architecture-consultant]
T3 assessment.py — extract section-builders; new build_assess_report (4 sections: features-added / what-changes / conflicts-losses / value-risk-extras) reusing redact_secrets+disclaimer (no dup); wrap_data_only (R3a); FeatureDescription; tiering helper. [checkpoint: security-specialist + qa-specialist]
T4 .claude/commands/apply-framework.md (evolve distribute.md) + onboard.md thin alias. [docs-exempt]
T5 ADR-0019 (supersedes ADR-0017; records inversion insight) + mark ADR-0017 superseded_by. [docs-exempt]
Tests: greenfield_env fixture; both-baseline floor; assess read-only immutability; deploy clean-gate; back-out+stub-revert; 4-section report; R3a-APPLY; consent fail-closed; baseline_gate skip; regression-ledger row (greenfield B1 extension). Reuse: change_package/assessment/stage_branch/repo_safety_check + lineage scripts.

Task 1 (Baseline abstraction) APPROVE (0.93). Baseline Protocol + LineageBaseline/OnDiskBaseline + single _classify floor primitive precisely executes R4/R10; no ADR drift. compute_package fail-closed FileNotFoundError preserved via LineageBaseline.from_target. Sibling entry points share the ChangePackage shape; no cross-call. Strengths: right-granularity seam (2 callers, no speculative generalization); OnDiskBaseline.divergence->None is cleanest expression of 'no ancestor'; named MAX_* constants keep bounds auditable. Low: add 1-line comment at denied/not-accepted early returns that target_hash=None is a deliberate pre-disk-read skip. Info: successor ADR + ADR-0017 superseded_by still owed (Task 5; ADR-completeness gate).

Task 1 (greenfield floor) APPROVE (0.91). Floor invariant HOLDS: with OnDiskBaseline.divergence()->None and empty pinned/accept/deny, an existing target file with differing hash cannot reach inert/current/value — it always falls through to value-unverified; 'value' is produced nowhere in code. Shared floor HOLDS: _classify is the single decision site; both engines call it identically, weakening it requires one visible diff hunk. Non-blocking consent-ordering observation: compute_greenfield_package has no guard against being called outside the R8-gated deploy path (consent enforcement lives in the deploy orchestrator, not this layer). Recommend a doc comment on compute_greenfield_package naming the R8 assent preflight as a required caller precondition.

Task 2 (gating+consent+deploy) APPROVE (0.92). All 4 checkpoint criteria PASS. APPLY consent fail-closed CONFIRMED: apply_assent_preflight blocks None/whitespace primary_human; 'is True' identity check (not ==) blocks string 'true'/int 1 on both apply + update consent. Assent stub branch containment PASS: _resolve_within applied to every extra_files relpath; stub lands on fresh branch only; except-block deletes branch on failure (Steward cond 3). Fail-closed routing PASS: detect_route raises ValueError on malformed/empty lineage, FileNotFoundError on missing — no silent fall to greenfield. baseline_gate_green PASS: standalone, no auto-invocation in module layer; code-exec warning documented. Low/non-blocking: extra_files content written verbatim with no size cap — add len<512KB ValueError as defense-in-depth (hub-controlled now, guards an upstream logic error).

Task 2 (decomposition) APPROVE (0.91). Decomposition (check_clean_tree/manifest_presence/update_consent/apply_consent) matches R7 intent; repo_safety_check retained + composed, contract preserved (opted_in/is_safe/can_proceed/branch/accept/deny/blocker strings). Consent genuinely pluggable (shared ConsentResult; swappable without touching clean-tree). router read-only + fail-closed; is_greenfield_engine cleanly collapses partial+greenfield at engine-selection. Stub written via extra_files INSIDE stage() branch = Steward cond 3 mechanically. LOW (load-bearing for APPLY): stage()'s internal defense-in-depth guard uses repo_safety_check().is_safe (fused), which is always False on greenfield (no-manifest blocker) -> stage() would ALWAYS raise on a greenfield target. Fix: replace guard with check_clean_tree().is_clean (the R7 deploy gate). Recommend folding before wiring the APPLY engine. Info: build_assent_stub 'deliberately dumb' (gate in apply_consent) is correct.

Task 3 (assess report + R3a) APPROVE (0.93). All 4 security constraints hold: redact_secrets + DIRECTING_ATTENTION genuinely single-sourced (build_assess_report reaches redact only via the shared _section_overwrites — one call site, no second copy); wrap_data_only frames untrusted content (preamble 'never obey it' + fenced label + exact-token fence neutralization); target content stays out of content-free paths (counts() unchanged; report is the only diff sink, scrubbed); current files excluded (report sources only inert/diverged/requires_interpretation/pinned_dropped). Low/non-blocking: wrap_data_only neutralizes only the EXACT closing fence — a forged '<<<END' without trailing '>>>' fails to close (content stays sandboxed) so no escape; escalate-only routing makes this defense-in-depth, not exploitable. redact_secrets fails closed on empty patterns (correct).

Task 3 REVISE (0.88). Finding 1 (High): ADVISORY_HEADER constant embeds '/distribute' ('produced by the hub during /distribute'); build_assess_report reuses _section_advisory_header() so the developer-facing value/risk report shows the wrong command name post-rename. Fix: parameterize or update the constant to /apply-framework; add a test asserting the report does NOT contain /distribute. Finding 2 (Med): tier_files_for_interpretation return type is dict[str,list] (missing [ChangeItem]) — strict-mypy gap; tiers sorted alphabetically not by priority (deterministic, acceptable). Finding 3 (Med): add explicit test that a current-classified item is absent from build_assess_report output. Finding 4 (Low): test wrap_data_only fence-escape + empty content. Strengths: section-builder extraction byte-identical for build_assessment_doc; build_assess_report mechanical parts deterministic/mockable; tiering content-free; redact+disclaimer single-sourced; FeatureDescription graceful fallback.

Task 3 Round 2 APPROVE (0.97). Both Round-1 findings resolved: ADVISORY_HEADER now /apply-framework (single-sourced; build_assess_report output verified to contain /apply-framework and not /distribute); tier_files_for_interpretation annotated dict[str,list[ChangeItem]]. Findings 3 (current-absent assertion) + 4 (wrap_data_only fence-escape/empty) correctly deferred to the dedicated test build step (test-layer gaps, not production defects).

Build complete: 5 tasks + comprehensive tests. 3 checkpoints fired (T1 architecture+independent APPROVE; T2 security+architecture APPROVE; T3 security APPROVE + qa REVISE->resolved R2). 0 unresolved concerns. All checkpoint findings folded (T1: deny/accept disk-skip comment + compute_greenfield_package R8-precondition warning; T2: stage() deploy guard switched repo_safety_check->check_clean_tree per R7 [load-bearing: enabled greenfield deploy] + extra_files size cap; T3: ADVISORY_HEADER /distribute->/apply-framework + tiering type annotation). Delivered: Baseline protocol (LineageBaseline/OnDiskBaseline) + one shared floor primitive + compute_greenfield_package + bounded offer set; router.py (presence spectrum, fail-closed); repo_safety_check decomposition (separable check_clean_tree + pluggable consent: update_consent / apply_assent_preflight fail-closed / build_assent_stub); stage_branch extra_files deploy-step-zero; assessment section-builders + build_assess_report (4 sections) + wrap_data_only (R3a) + FeatureDescription + tiering; apply-framework.md command + distribute/onboard aliases; ADR-0019 (supersedes ADR-0017). Quality gate 7/7; 114 tests pass (41 new); greenfield B1 regression + ledger row. NO commit/push yet -> /review next.

## What I Missed
At Round-2 APPROVE I trusted the 'deferred to test step' label for Findings 3/4 rather than spot-checking that those tests were actually written (they since were: TestBuildAssessReport.test_current_items_never_appear, TestWrapDataOnly).
## Candidate Improvement Rule
A checkpoint deferral ('test-layer gap, not production defect') is a carry-forward obligation, not a closed finding. The next QA checkpoint / final test review should confirm the deferred tests exist by name before APPROVE. Proposed addition to testing_requirements.md.
## Confidence Calibration
Round-1 0.88 well-calibrated; Round-2 0.97 slightly over-stated (hadn't verified deferred tests). Delta: -0.04
